say:1:1035803001:1.text: From the moment you arrived, a connection with evil was made.
say:1:1035803001:1.source_cn: 一旦来到这里，就意味着已经和邪恶产生联结。
say:1:1035803001:1.male: From the moment you arrived, a connection with evil was made.
say:1:1035803001:1.female: From the moment you arrived, a connection with evil was made.

say:2:1035803002:1.text: But praise be to Dura, protection has come. The temple will obey her will and protect this place.
say:2:1035803002:1.source_cn: 幸运的是，女神已降下了庇护。圣堂将遵从她的意志，守卫此地。
say:2:1035803002:1.male: But praise be to Dura, protection has come. The temple will obey her will and protect this place.
say:2:1035803002:1.female: But praise be to Dura, protection has come. The temple will obey her will and protect this place.

say:3:1035803003:1.text: Pray to Dura. Let her mercy expunge the evil from this land. There is no other choice for our salvation.
say:3:1035803003:1.source_cn: ——祈祷吧。向女神艾雅祈祷。愿她的慈悲洗去那些邪恶。除...
say:3:1035803003:1.male: Pray to Dura. Let her mercy expunge the evil from this land. There is no other choice for our salvation.
say:3:1035803003:1.female: Pray to Dura. Let her mercy expunge the evil from this land. There is no other choice for our salvation.
